newsitem.title: THAILAND: Dynamic Eastern denies liquidity rumours.
newsitem.headline: Dynamic Eastern denies liquidity rumours.

text.p: Dynamic Eastern Finance Thailand (1991) Plc on Friday denied stock market rumours and newspaper reports that the company was hit by liquidity problems.
Dynamic Eastern Finance said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that the market rumours and the newpapers reports were untrue.

The company said that it had a total capital of about 2.8 billion baht ($107.69 million) while its total assets as of last December 31 was 15.590 billion and that it was operating its business normally.

Rumours hit the market after central bank governor's comments on Thursday that his bank had directed at least one small finance firm that was hit by short-term liquidity problems to restructure its capital.
The Bank of Thailand has denied the comments, saying no financial institutions under its supervision were faced with liquidity problems.
